couplings.description: Registry freeze assumes DEFAULT_CONFIG logistic_strong_reg; optimizer ranks different candidates
load_phase9_9_bundle defaults build_if_missing=True; production callers must opt out explicitly
RangeEngineAdapter.load ignores caller base_dir; always load_phase9_9_bundle(base_dir=None)
paper/config EXPECTED_FEATURES from DEFAULT_CONFIG at import; not loaded from artifact feature_order.json
HealthGate checks metadata/feature_order file existence; model.pkl failure is separate via verify_bundle_integrity
Sidecar JSON can exist while model.pkl missing — health may fail predict check but files partially present
ShadowEngine and KernelShadowRunner can invoke freeze without acceptance gate
PipelineCache uses build_if_missing=False — does NOT trigger rebuild (safe read path)
metadata.robustness_score read from report JSON at freeze time; stale if report updated without re-freeze
EngineRegistry loads bundle twice: load_phase9_9_bundle + RangeEngineAdapter.load (separate bundle instances)
